title: a new duplicate import of one module
how: ESLint no-duplicate-imports (imports only) on the JS files the diff touches, at base and at head

explain.what: A file imports from the same module in two import lines.
explain.why: Two imports of one module make it harder to see what the file uses, and they often mean a merge or an edit went wrong.
explain.fix: Merge them into one import line.

base.src/m.mjs:
import { a } from './a.mjs';
export const m = a;
